decisions.reason: A multi-model line close to the core offer and shown prominently on the home page represents sizable, visible investment that management would want to justify, so it persists.
A single pyramid model close to the core range carries little cost to keep, and its prominent display makes dropping it look like an admission of error.
As a multi-model flagship line publicly framed as the firm's new direction, it embodies the strongest commitment, and weak results would be attributed to temporary causes.
It received a second edition and a page of its own, and it is tied to the flagship music box system, which signals continued commitment.
This small seasonal add-on had only modest visibility, but it supports the flagship music box line, so dropping it would undercut that announced direction.
It builds on the core pyramid craft and was featured on the home page, so the investment and visible commitment favour keeping it.
